prompt: Design a high-tier wilderness site for a party with flight and teleportation. Labeled fixture.
expected_output: The design respects party capabilities and gives honest costs, exposure, limits, or new opportunities rather than arbitrarily negating them.

assertions.text: States what flight and teleportation can accomplish
Uses fiction-based constraints (visibility, anchors, weather, exposure, incomplete information) only where justified
Does not make every route a fake wall or declare abilities invalid without a setting reason
